input.overview: The repeatable plan is Dilithium Multiball. Collect the five flashing crystals, hit the center Primary Crystal to open the Transporter beneath the ramp, and shoot that opening for three-ball play. During Multiball, alternate the moving Primary Crystal and the Transporter to relight and collect Jackpots.
input.simpleOverview: Collect all five flashing Dilithium crystals, hit the lit center Primary Crystal, then shoot the open Transporter under the ramp for three-ball Multiball. During it, hit the yellow Primary Crystal and return to the green Transporter for each Jackpot.
input.summary: Follow the five flashing Dilithium crystal shots. When the Primary Crystal lights, hit it to open the Transporter, then shoot beneath the ramp for three-ball Multiball. Repeat Primary Crystal then Transporter for Jackpots while two or more balls remain.

quickInfo.name: Dilithium crystals
quickInfo.summary: Five flashing crystal shots qualify the center Primary Crystal. The display and insert lamps show which crystals remain.

quickInfo.name: Transporter Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Hit the lit Primary Crystal to open the Transporter beneath the ramp, then shoot the opening to start automatic three-ball play.

quickInfo.name: Jackpot loop
quickInfo.summary: During Multiball, hit the moving Primary Crystal while yellow, then shoot the green open Transporter for the Jackpot. Repeat the pair.

quickInfo.name: Phasers
quickInfo.summary: Left ramp, right ramp, and Primary Crystal advance the phasers. When their lamps are complete, hit the Primary Crystal for Million Plus.

quickInfo.name: Warship skill shot
quickInfo.summary: Press the launch/fire button when the moving warship is centered for the maximum award.

steps.text: On the plunge, watch the moving warship and press the launch/fire button when it reaches the center.
Shoot whichever Dilithium crystal inserts are flashing until all five have been collected.
Hit the lit moving Primary Crystal in the center. This opens the Transporter beneath the ramp.
Shoot the open Transporter under the ramp to beam up the crew and start automatic three-ball Multiball.
During Multiball, hit the moving Primary Crystal while it is yellow to light the Transporter green.
Shoot the green open Transporter for the Jackpot, then repeat Primary Crystal followed by Transporter while at least two balls remain.
After one ball remains, follow the newly flashing Dilithium crystal inserts.
Complete all five again and hit the relit Primary Crystal.
Return to the reopened Transporter to start the next three-ball Multiball.

playfieldReferences.label: Center Primary Crystal
playfieldReferences.description: The moving center target that opens the Transporter and relights its Jackpot during Multiball.

playfieldReferences.label: Transporter under the ramp
playfieldReferences.description: The opening beneath the ramp used to start Multiball and collect its Jackpots.

playfieldReferences.label: Right mystery scoop
playfieldReferences.description: The scoop that awards lit mystery features, including Video Mode on stock software.

cautions.issue: Unofficial 3.00 custom code exists for this machine.
cautions.response: These rules apply to the stock official game. If the display advertises unofficial 3.00, expect changed behavior and follow that ROM's display.
